strings.about_ack_body: This app was conceived by Mr. Marlon “Waleed” Feliciano, and made possible by Rouell “Omar” Mico.
strings.about_ack_dua: We ask that you remember us both in your prayers. InshaAllah.
strings.about_feature_guides: Reference guides — wudu, mistakes in the prayer, missed prayers, travel and combining, and a glossary
strings.about_feature_schools: Where the four schools of law differ, all four positions are shown side by side, with your selected school marked
strings.about_feature_sources: Every ruling names the source it comes from
strings.about_feature_steps: Every prayer walked through one step at a time — niyyah, takbir, Al-Fatiha, ruku', sujood, through to the end
strings.about_feature_times: Prayer times for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Witr and Qiyam, calculated on your device from your location
strings.about_no_app_to_open: No app on this device can open that.
strings.about_pdf_body: A printable guide to performing the salah, included with the app. Open it here, or share it with someone who cannot install the app.
strings.about_pdf_failed: That file could not be opened. Please try again.
strings.about_share_text:
Salah App — a step-by-step prayer guide for new Muslims.

%1$s
strings.about_tagline: A step-by-step prayer guide for new Muslims.
strings.arabic_voice_unavailable: No Arabic voice is installed for read-aloud.
strings.calibration_desc: To calibrate the compass, move your phone in a figure-8 pattern several times.
strings.home_subtitle: Step-by-step prayer guide for new Muslims

strings.location_enable_action: Show prayer times for my location
strings.location_unavailable: Your location could not be found. Please try again.
strings.privacy_options_caption: Change whether this app may use your data for personalised ads. Your choice can be updated at any time.
strings.privacy_options_unavailable: That form could not be opened just now. Please check your connection and try again.
strings.qibla_needs_location: Your location is needed to show the Qibla direction.
strings.qiyam_desc: Best time for Tahajjud and Witr
strings.step_ayat_kursi_instr: Recite Ayat-ul-Kursi after every fard prayer.
strings.step_ayat_kursi_trans: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Everlasting... (Ayat-ul-Kursi)
strings.step_dhikr1_instr: After Salam, remain seated and recite this.
strings.step_dhikr1_trans:
I seek Allah's forgiveness (3 times).

O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of Majesty and Honor.
strings.step_dhikr2_trans: There is no god but Allah, alone without partner... O Allah, none can withhold what You give and none can give what You withhold.
strings.step_dhikr3_trans: There is no power nor strength except with Allah... He alone we worship...
strings.step_dhikr4_instr: Recite this 10 times after Fajr and Maghrib (Sunnah).
strings.step_dhikr4_trans: There is no god but Allah... He gives life and causes death... (10 times)
strings.step_fatiha_trans:
In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Master of the Day of Judgment
You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
Guide us to the straight path
The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor
Not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
strings.step_itidal_instr: Stand up straight from ruku'. Recite while rising.
strings.step_itidal_trans:
Allah hears whoever praises Him
Our Lord, and to You be all praise
strings.step_niyyah_instr: Stand upright, facing the Qiblah. Make the intention in your heart (no need to say it out loud).
strings.step_opening_dua_instr: Recite this silently after Takbiratul Ihram and before Al-Fatiha.
strings.step_opening_dua_trans:
Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You, and blessed is Your Name, and exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no god but You.

I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.
strings.step_ruku_instr: Bow down — hands resting on knees. Back should be straight and parallel to the floor. Say 3 times.
strings.step_ruku_trans: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent (3 times)
strings.step_salam_left_instr: Turn your head to the left and say the salam.
strings.step_salam_right_instr: Turn your head to the right and say the salam.
strings.step_salam_trans: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah
strings.step_salawat_instr: Recite the Salawat/Durood Ibrahim after Tashahhud in the final raka'at.
strings.step_salawat_trans:
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
As You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious

O Allah, grant Your blessings to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
As You granted blessings to Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious
strings.step_sitting_between_instr: Sit for a moment between the two sujoods.
strings.step_sujood_instr: Prostrate — forehead, nose, both palms, both knees, and both sets of toes on the floor.
strings.step_sujood_trans: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High (3 times)
strings.step_surah_instr: Recite any surah. Example: Suratul Ikhlas (Al-Ikhlas 112).
strings.step_surah_trans:
Say: He is Allah, [who is] One
Allah, the Eternal Refuge
He neither begets nor is born
Nor is there to Him any equivalent
strings.step_takbir_ihram_instr: Raise both hands to the level of your ears and say the Takbir.
strings.step_takbir_ruku_instr: Say 'Allaahu Akbar' before or while bowing for Ruku'.
strings.step_takbir_second_sujood_instr: Say 'Allaahu Akbar' while going down for the second Sujood.
strings.step_takbir_sitting_instr: Say 'Allaahu Akbar' while rising from Sujood to sit.
strings.step_takbir_sujood_instr: Say 'Allaahu Akbar' while going down for Sujood.
strings.step_takbir_tashahhud_instr: Say 'Allaahu Akbar' while rising from Sujood for Tashahhud (remaining seated).
strings.step_tasbih33_instr: Count using the fingers of your right hand.
strings.step_tasbih33_trans: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is Greatest (33 times). Complete 100 by reciting there is no god but Allah...
strings.step_tashahhud_first_instr: Sit and recite the Tashahhud. Then, stand up for the next raka'at.
strings.step_tashahhud_instr: Sit and recite the Tashahhud. Point your index finger (shahadah finger) at 'Ash-hadu'.
strings.step_tashahhud_trans:
All greetings, prayers and goodness are for Allah
Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy and blessings of Allah
Peace be upon us and upon all the righteous servants of Allah
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah
And I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger
strings.step_three_quls_instr: Recite the last three surahs of the Qur'an (Once in other prayers, 3 times in Fajr and Maghrib).
strings.step_why_collapse_cd: Hide why this step is done
strings.step_why_expand_cd: Show why this step is done
